title: Sindh Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1973
ACT VIII OF 1973
SIND INDUSTRIAL
TRADING ESTATE RECOVERY OF DUES ACT, 1973
An Act to provide
for recovery of the dues of the Sind Industrial Trading Estate
[Gazette of Sind
Extraordinary, Part IV 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PP.S/Legis-B-8/73.---The
Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973 and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Act ratty be called the Sind Industrial Trading
Estate Recovery of Dues Act, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole
Province of Sind.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of Sind

(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PP.S/Legis-B-8/73.---The
Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973 and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
2. Definitions.--In this
Act, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say-
(a) "defaulter" means a
person from whom any dues are recoverable by the Sind Industrial Trading Estate
and includes a person who is responsible as surety for payment of any such
dues;
(b) "Government" means the
Government of Sind ; and
(c) "Sind industrial Trading
Estate" means the Sind industrial Trading Estate Company created under
Sind Government Resolution No. 24-I.B/47-1, dated 2nd June 1947.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Act 1973
sections.description:
Declaration of dues

ACT VIII OF 1973
ACT VIII OF 1973
SIND INDUSTRIAL
TRADING ESTATE RECOVERY OF DUES ACT, 1973
An Act to provide
for recovery of the dues of the Sind Industrial Trading Estate
[Gazette of Sind
Extraordinary, Part IV 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PP.S/Legis-B-8/73.---The
Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Bill, 1973 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973 and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
3. Declaration of dues.---(1)
Government may by notification declare that any dues or class of dues
.recoverable by Sind Industrial Trading Estate shall be recoverable from
defaulters as if such dues were the arrears of land-revenue.
(2) On publication of the
notification under subsection (1) any such dues shall be recoverable under the
Revenue Recovery Act, 1890 (Act I of 1890) as arrears of land revenue.
